title: Sentinel
description: Synthetic monitoring: probe state and failure reasons, latency, HTTP phases, DNS/TCP/TLS probes, certificates, scrape cost, runtime.

panels.title: Version
panels.description: After a rollout: does every instance run the same build?

panels.title: Scrape
panels.description: Prometheus' own up for the Sentinel targets. Sentinel exports no readiness gauge; /readyz is a separate HTTP check. last_over_time keeps a dead instance in the join for a day, so it shows as down instead of disappearing.

panels.title: Targets
panels.description: Targets in the result store matching the filters.

panels.title: Failing
panels.description: The primary alert from metrics.md: sentinel_probe_success == 0. The reason is in the failure table below.

panels.title: Earliest chain expiry
panels.description: Across the whole chain, not the leaf: an intermediate or root expiring first breaks the connection just as surely. Red below 14 days matches the recommended alert.

panels.title: Skipped runs (1h)
panels.description: A run is skipped when the previous one of the same target is still in flight. Rising means the interval is too tight for how long the target takes.

panels.title: Render cost
panels.description: Time to gather all series on the last scrape (one scrape behind). Size scrape_timeout 2-3x above it; orange/red assume the documented 10s timeout.

panels.title: Probe state
panels.description: Sampled at scrape time: a failure shorter than the scrape interval can be missed.

panels.title: Targets
panels.description: Availability is the share of scrapes, not of probes, in the selected range. An empty 'since last success' means the target never succeeded since Sentinel started.

panels.title: Current failures
panels.description: sentinel_probe_failure_info exists only while a target fails, so this table is empty when everything is fine. Exactly one reason per failing target.

panels.title: Failing targets by reason
panels.description: certificate_expiring and tls_policy_violation only occur for targets with tls.expect.

panels.title: Skipped runs
panels.description: Overload protection of the scheduler. Lengthen the target's interval or shorten its timeout.

panels.title: Probe duration p95
panels.description: All probe types, successful runs only (failures are carried by probe_success). For HTTP this covers all redirect hops. Buckets end at 10s.

panels.title: HTTP TTFB p95
panels.description: Time from request sent to first response byte, successful HTTP probes only. The red line is the 'slow response' alert from metrics.md (p95 > 1s over 10m).

panels.title: Probe duration p50 / p95 / p99 (selection)
panels.description: One distribution over every selected target. Narrow the target filter to read a single one.

panels.title: HTTP TTFB mean
panels.description: Mean from the histogram's sum and count; finer than the bucket-based p95 for fast targets.

panels.title: DNS
panels.description: Zero when the connection was reused or the host is an IP address. Last-value gauge: shows the probe current at each scrape, not every probe.

panels.title: TCP connect
panels.description: Last-value gauge: shows the probe current at each scrape, not every probe.

panels.title: TLS handshake
panels.description: Zero for plain HTTP. Last-value gauge: shows the probe current at each scrape, not every probe.

panels.title: Download
panels.description: Reading the response body. Last-value gauge: shows the probe current at each scrape, not every probe.

panels.title: Status code
panels.description: Absent when no response arrived. The failure reason is http_status_error when it does not match.

panels.title: Redirects followed
panels.description: On the last probe.

panels.title: Served over TLS
panels.description: 1 -> 0 is a target that silently stopped using TLS (the 'TLS silently dropped' alert).

panels.title: DNS response code
panels.description: RCODE: 0 NOERROR, 2 SERVFAIL, 3 NXDOMAIN, 5 REFUSED.

panels.title: DNS answer count
panels.description: Records of the queried type. A drop to zero with NOERROR is an empty answer, not an outage.

panels.title: TCP connect duration
panels.description: Includes name resolution.

panels.title: TLS probe: DNS
panels.description: Only type="tls" targets; HTTPS reports the same phases in the HTTP row.

panels.title: TLS probe: connect
panels.description: Only type="tls" targets; HTTPS reports the same phases in the HTTP row.

panels.title: TLS probe: handshake
panels.description: Only type="tls" targets; HTTPS reports the same phases in the HTTP row.

panels.title: Chain not verified
panels.description: Also counts targets with tls.insecure_skip_verify: they probe successfully but are untrusted.

panels.title: Certificate invalid
panels.description: Chain, hostname and validity window. Stays honest under insecure_skip_verify.

panels.title: OCSP revoked
panels.description: Does not fail the probe unless tls.expect.require_ocsp_stapling is set, hence its own tile.

panels.title: OCSP staple stale
panels.description: Past NextUpdate: browsers may reject it while Sentinel's probe still succeeds.

panels.title: SHA-1 signatures
panels.description: A finding regardless of expiry.

panels.title: Weak RSA keys
panels.description: RSA keys below 2048 bits.

targets.expr: count(sentinel_tls_certificate_key_bits{instance=~"$instance",environment=~"$environment",service=~"$service",type=~"$type",target=~"$target"} < 2048 and on (job, instance, target) sentinel_tls_certificate_info{instance=~"$instance",environment=~"$environment",service=~"$service",type=~"$type",target=~"$target",public_key_algorithm="RSA"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Certificates
panels.description: Only targets that negotiated TLS appear here: plain HTTP emits no sentinel_tls_* series at all.

panels.title: Remaining days (chain)
panels.description: A sawtooth: falls steadily and jumps back on renewal. A line that does not jump back is the finding.

panels.title: Certificate identity
panels.description: Subject alternative names are deliberately not a label; see san_count. Serial and fingerprint are lowercase hex as openssl and CT logs show them.

panels.title: Negotiated TLS versions
panels.description: What was negotiated, not what the server additionally supports.

panels.title: OCSP staple status
panels.description: invalid: the staple was present but not signed by the issuer or not for this certificate.

panels.title: Render vs. full scrape
panels.description: Render is Sentinel's gather time; the full scrape adds encoding and network as measured by Prometheus. Raising scrape_interval lowers this cost without slowing down probing.

panels.title: Samples per scrape
panels.description: O(N) in targets: about 10 series per plain HTTP target, 25 per HTTPS target, plus 14 per histogram (12 buckets, sum, count).

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: 1 = one core.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: RSS is reported on Linux only; on macOS only the heap line appears.

panels.title: Goroutines
panels.description: Roughly constant per target. Steady growth at a fixed target count is a leak.
